title: spec: the cbp-master-detail-required-defaulted conversion still says the parse refuses an explicit `required: false` master, which is no longer true after #30905
body:
domain:server#1 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cytLmJxfAmgPVjUbbW

Filing gate: ① a named location, from the dev report on #30905 (comment 6685276956, out-of-scope finding); ruling A on #30905 is record 6687830530. ⛔ Not a claim.

Under ruling A, PR #30940 makes a `controlled_by_parent` object's sole `master_detail` with `required: false` a valid optional master. `packages/spec/src/conversions/entries/18/cbp-master-detail-required-defaulted.ts` still says otherwise: its docblock (about :23 and :56-60) says the builder refuses an explicit `required: false` and a live author meets the parse's refusal, and the inline comment about :110 says "refused by the builder". The entry's description string (about :82) may need the same check. The file was on #30905's ⛔ list, so it was left as is. The conversion's behaviour is right: an omitted `required` is still defaulted to required, and an explicit `required: false` is still not converted.

Wanted: the docblock and comments say what the code does after #30940; if the description string is shown to authors (upgrade output), it is corrected too and the changeset level follows. No behaviour change.

Suggested grade: p3, `domain:spec`. Serial: after PR #30940 lands; it may ride #30907 (docs and skills, card 3/3) if that lane prefers.
